messages:
elena: Quick oddity — p95 jumped ~200ms for /v1/chat in the latency pane but p99 didn't move. Saw this at 10:12PT, screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/abc
sam: Hmm, did any routing policy or fallback get adjusted around that time?
ajay: Could also be sampling origin change — endpoint vs route aggregation source mismatch. Can you paste the console query?
elena: Sure — the pane is using the 'endpoint.latency' rollup with tags: `route=/v1/chat, env=prod` and aggregation mode `p95`.

```
query {
  metric: endpoint.latency
  by: [route]
  agg: p95
  window: 5m
  include_retries: true
}
```
marco: Ah — we recently enabled fallthrough-weighting for routing which changes which backend contributes samples. If the rollback picks a faster model for a subset, p99 will stay stable but p95 can shift if the mass of samples move.
dash-bot: telemetry: noticed sample_origin flipped from `client` -> `proxy` at 10:11:58 for /v1/chat
sam: Can you check sample counts? p95 is sensitive to many mid-tail shifts if sample_count distribution changes.
elena: sample_count dropped from 1200 -> 430 at the same minute. That's probably it.
ajay: That indicates a sampling/filtering change, not a code perf regression. For console UX we should show 'sample_origin' badge on quantile panes so users see provenance quickly.
marco: For short-term, toggle `include_retries=false` in query and re-evaluate — that often normalizes p95.
elena: Tried that — include_retries=false brings p95 back to baseline. So it's retries inflating mid-percentile mass.
sam: Action: (1) Add sample_origin badge to latency pane (product ticket). (2) Add quick toggle for include_retries in the pane. (3) Investigate why proxy sampling dropped.
marco: I'll open infra issue and link logs. deploy-bot: infra/rollback-proxy-sampling @marco created issue INFRA-877
elena: Thanks — filing console UX ticket: CONS-402. Keeping this thread for follow-ups :thumbsup:
